name: contract-audio-retention
goal: Retain class-generated audio in revision-bound proof and Examples with failures and provenance intact

evidence: TestArtifactService writes registered WAV artifacts and transcripts, but focusedScreens filters out audio and readRegression only decodes images. Earlier capture tests checked stored bytes and notes, never the sealed capture/history boundary, so generated class examples disappear.

Extend the existing single TestArtifactService.capture initialized case through gathering, focused retention and sealed history reading. Keep playable bytes, transcript, unit/case/revision/hash, failure outcomes and invalid binding checks in that same method case; retain all existing byte-snapshot and invalid-prop assertions.
